# Java XDK (`com.x:xdk` v0.1.2)

> Official Java client library for the X API v2 (Java 17+). Install with `implementation("com.x:xdk:0.1.2")`.

## Guides

- [Java overview](https://docs.x.com/xdks/java/overview.md): Overview and quick example
- [Java install](https://docs.x.com/xdks/java/install.md): Installation and requirements
- [Java quickstart](https://docs.x.com/xdks/java/quickstart.md): Make your first X API v2 request
- [Java authentication](https://docs.x.com/xdks/java/authentication.md): Bearer Token, OAuth 2.0 PKCE, and OAuth 1.0a
- [Java pagination](https://docs.x.com/xdks/java/pagination.md): Cursor pagination across multi-page endpoints
- [Java streaming](https://docs.x.com/xdks/java/streaming.md): Real-time event streams and filtered stream rules

## Client Reference

- [Reference Overview](https://docs.x.com/xdks/java/reference/overview.md): Client options and client list
- [`AccountClient` (Account)](https://docs.x.com/xdks/java/reference/clients/account.md): 2 methods via `client.account()`
- [`AccountActivityClient` (Account Activity)](https://docs.x.com/xdks/java/reference/clients/account-activity.md): 5 methods via `client.accountActivity()`
